messages:
Maya: Quick sync — planning to roll out the runtime flag `surge_throttle_v1` to handle sudden traffic spikes. Thinking: dry-run shadowing, telemetry gating, and a clear rollback playbook. Any preferences?
Oliver: +1 to shadow first. start at 10% for 24h then evaluate. Gate on p95 latency and error-rate. If either breaches, hold.
Sam: We should also do quota-aware fallback. If throttle threshold hit, route heavy tenants to fallback model-variant or apply tenant-level soft rate-limit. Need a clear ops flow.
engops: Ops suggestion: circuit-breaker with a `min_traffic_window` and an emergency pause in console. Example config snippet: ```circuit_breaker: {min_window_ms: 30000, error_pct_threshold: 1.0, cooldown_secs: 300}```. Also add a manual "pause rollout" button.
config-bot: Dry-run created: dr_2026_07_01_01 — shadowing 10% of production traffic. Dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/dryruns/dr_2026_07_01_01
Maya: For telemetry we need token-level cost delta, per-route p95 latency, and sampled input examples (small corpus) for quick regression evals. Also need per-cohort traffic counts.
Oliver: I propose automatic decay: 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 48h if no veto. Veto thresholds: p95 latency +5% absolute, error-rate +1% absolute. Veto causes immediate pause and notify #incidents.
Sam: Make veto automated. Rule should rollback flag and run a targeted eval against the sampled inputs. Alert rule example: ```WHEN p95_latency > baseline*1.05 OR error_rate > baseline+0.01 THEN rollback_flag('surge_throttle_v1') AND alert('#incidents')```
engops: I'll author the playbook steps: 1) Pause rollout, 2) Capture traces & sampled inputs, 3) Run regression evals, 4) Rollback within 5m if needed, 5) Postmortem if >30m customer impact. I'll upload to Ops Runbooks and link from the console.
Maya: Nice. Can someone add two console UI toggles: "Enable dry-run (shadow)" and "Auto-escalate on veto"? Also a small inline note explaining sampling strategy.
Oliver: I'll open a tiny PR for the UI checkbox and the API param `auto_escalate=true|false`. Keeping API backward compatible.
Sam: One more ask — surface quota headroom on the rollout dashboard so reviewers know which customers could be impacted.
engops: Good call. We'll add per-tenant throttle heatmap and a low-headroom warning.
Maya: Great, thanks all. I'll merge the rollout checklist into the config RFC after the PRs land.
Oliver: Acked. I'll include test vectors for the sampled inputs in the PR.
config-bot: Reminder: dry-run dr_2026_07_01_01 will auto-escalate at 2026-07-02T02:00Z unless paused.
Maya: keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the rollout checklist. Ping me if anything blocks.
